Teenagers today
Teenagers are the future of our society. In this unit, let's explore some great qualities
of teenagers. What is a responsible teenager like? Are teenagers today creative? What
important roles do they play in our country? By the end of this unit, you will recommend
a role model for your class.
After completing the unit, you will be able to：
• use words and expressions in the unit to talk about teenagers.
• use adverbial clauses with if and because to talk about the qualities of responsible
teenagers.
• describe role models.

on the money
What can you see in the picture？
People use money every day. In this unit, let's explore money. Do you spend your money
wisely? How can you help others with money? People often say that we can't live without
money - but is that true? By the end of this unit, you will make a plan for using your
pocket money.
After completing the unit, you will be able to：
• use words and expressions in the unit to talk about money.
• use adverbial clauses with when and where to give advice on managing money.
• share your opinion on the use of money.

Every culture has its history. In this unit, let's explore the importance of history. How do
we discover the past? What are some of the mysteries of history? What are the best ways
to pass on history? By the end of this unit, you will make a class book about history.
After completing the unit, you will be able to：
• use words and expressions in the unit to talk about history.
• use adverbial clauses with such / so...that and so that to talk about archaeological
discoveries.
• explain the importance of learning about and passing on history.

Unit
4
Heroes
Heroes inspire us and help shape a better world. In this unit, let's explore heroes from
different times. What makes a hero? Is it the courage to protect the nation? Or is it taking
responsibility in difficult situations? Or is it doing the hard work to improve people's lives？
By the end of this unit, you will make a short video about a local hero.
After completing the unit, you will be able to：
• use words and expressions in the unit to talk about heroes.
• use attributive clauses with who to tell stories of heroes.
• describe the qualities of heroes.

Unit
6
Live green
Green living is a new lifestyle. In this unit, let's explore how to live green. What environmental
problems do we have today? What can we do for a greener life? Why should we take
responsibility for the environment? By the end of this unit, you will make a report on your
family's environmental habits.
After completing the unit, you will be able to：
• use words and expressions in the unit to talk about green living.
• use word formation in discussions about environmental problems.
• suggest ways to live a green life.
